note: Four items, for checking that the session tool runs. Not a measurement: the texts here were written by the coordinator, which is exactly what item-bank.md forbids for a real bank. It places no repeat either — a copy has to sit at least eight trials after its original, and four items have nowhere to put one.

instructions.on: state what it does and why it is good

on.text: The driver returns a structured report of everything the seat did, which makes it far easier to see what really happened and gives you confidence the work was genuinely carried out.

off.text: The driver returns a structured report of the events the seat produced. Read it to see which commands ran and what they returned.

instructions.on: use the literal phrase where one exists

on.text: Exit 0 summarises the checks that ran. It does not establish that the task succeeded.

off.text: Exit 0 is a green light on the dashboard, not a signed delivery note for the work itself.

on.text: Create no config file. The driver reads its settings from the environment, and a missing config is the normal case rather than an error.

off.text: Most tools of this kind expect a config file, and its absence usually means something is wrong. This one inherits its settings from the environment instead. So: create no config file.
